                example '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw
                'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or null when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                the region code derived from the owner's postcode/city, the
                two-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest
                over the owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last
                name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing member id,
                '-<n>' is appended with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it
                unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. Each fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 upper-case hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and its postcode. Owners that share a last
                name and postcode share this value automatically. Null when the
                last name or postcode is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created, i.e. before this create. Zero when the name
                was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0 and accumulating: 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when the owner had no
                namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of
                3 or more members, and 3 for tenure of one or more elapsed
                fiscal years (the number of 1-July fiscal-year boundaries
                between the registration date and the current date).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this
                owner's registration date, signalling a bulk-signup surge;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners (inclusive), signalling that it is approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of the following hold, otherwise false: the owner
                is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true); the owner's
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocked
                disposable domain, but a subdomain of one or sharing the base
                label of one, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or 'x.mailinator.com'); or
                the owner's city is over its soft capacity (already holds 40 or
                more owners, the soft capacity below the per-city hard limit of
                50).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained but flagged deleted and
                is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was flagged a possible (soft-match)
                duplicate at creation: it was not a hard duplicate, yet it
                shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), or null when it is
                not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate measured against
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' from 65 on. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space
                and the lastName when a title is present (e.g. 'DR Who'), or
                just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256
                digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' (the
                telephone and email components empty when absent). Two owners are
                considered duplicates only when their whole identity keys are
                equal; a create is rejected with 409 on an exact full-key match
                against an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '3b8c2f0e1d5a9c7b4e6f8a0d2c1b3e5f7a9c0d2e4f6a8c0b1d3e5f7a9c1b3d5e'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner resource, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Null when the owner
                has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional client-supplied key that makes the create idempotent. When
            a create repeats with a key already seen, the originally created
            owner is returned with 200 instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create repeated an already-seen idempotency key; the originally
            created owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is
            one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and is used to compose the
            read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional now that the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields exist; when the structured fields
            are supplied it is composed from them and returned as the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present. Supplying this flat form
            remains accepted for backward compatibility. An owner must supply an
            address in at least one form (a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat
            'address').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Optional; preferred over the flat 'address' when
            supplied and must be non-blank. Normalized on create (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (unit, suite, etc.). Normalized on create like 'addressLine1' and,
            when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: 'Apt 2B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: separators are stripped, a leading '+'
            keeps the supplied country code otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped, and the result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. For example '0412 345 678' is stored and
            returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's inclusive
            postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
            When supplied it must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-30'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand' and must
            not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            shares its household (same last name and postcode). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is then created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Optional
            and write-only; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw
                'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or null when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
                the region code derived from the owner's postcode/city, the
                two-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest
                over the owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last
                name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing member id,
                '-<n>' is appended with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it
                unique.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. Each fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 upper-case hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and its postcode. Owners that share a last
                name and postcode share this value automatically. Null when the
                last name or postcode is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created, i.e. before this create. Zero when the name
                was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0 and accumulating: 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when the owner had no
                namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of
                3 or more members, and 3 for tenure of one or more elapsed
                fiscal years (the number of 1-July fiscal-year boundaries
                between the registration date and the current date).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this
                owner's registration date, signalling a bulk-signup surge;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners (inclusive), signalling that it is approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of the following hold, otherwise false: the owner
                is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true); the owner's
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocked
                disposable domain, but a subdomain of one or sharing the base
                label of one, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or 'x.mailinator.com'); or
                the owner's city is over its soft capacity (already holds 40 or
                more owners, the soft capacity below the per-city hard limit of
                50).
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained but flagged deleted and
                is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was flagged a possible (soft-match)
                duplicate at creation: it was not a hard duplicate, yet it
                shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), or null when it is
                not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate measured against
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' from 65 on. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space
                and the lastName when a title is present (e.g. 'DR Who'), or
                just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256
                digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' (the
                telephone and email components empty when absent). Two owners are
                considered duplicates only when their whole identity keys are
                equal; a create is rejected with 409 on an exact full-key match
                against an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '3b8c2f0e1d5a9c7b4e6f8a0d2c1b3e5f7a9c0d2e4f6a8c0b1d3e5f7a9c1b3d5e'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner resource, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Null when the owner
                has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

+        identity algorithm (the region code used inside these identifiers mixes
+        in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so every value differs from its version-1
+        form). The 'V2' tag appears only inside these identifiers, never in the
+        user-facing locality, timezone or owner segment.
+            The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
+            the version-2 region code derived from the owner's postcode/city
+            (the plain region with a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in), the
+            two-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration
+            date, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest
+            over the owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last
+            name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
+            '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing member id,
+            '-<n>' is appended with the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it
+            A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 upper-case hex
+            characters of the SHA-256 digest over a fixed 'V2' version tag, the
+            owner's normalized last name and its postcode. Owners that share a
+            last name and postcode share this value automatically. Null when the
+            last name or postcode is absent.
+            The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest
+            over a fixed 'V2' version tag, the normalized telephone, the
+            lower-cased email and the surname's soundex (the telephone and email
+            components empty when absent). Two owners are considered duplicates

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional client-supplied key that makes the create idempotent. When
            a create repeats with a key already seen, the originally created
            owner is returned with 200 instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create repeated an already-seen idempotency key; the originally
            created owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner  not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}/pets:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addPetToOwner
      summary: Adds a pet to an owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
